name: Libya
overview: Scripture identifies Libya as a region north of Egypt, also referred to by the names Phut or Lubim, highlighting its significance among the nations surrounding Israel. In Ezekiel, Libya is depicted alongside other nations destined to face judgment, emphasizing God's sovereign control over all peoples. The mention in Acts situates Libya geographically near Cyrene, demonstrating the early spread of the gospel to diverse regions and peoples. These references collectively underscore Libya's role in biblical history as a recognized land among the nations under God's providence.
